grading.drop: The lowest two participation scores are dropped.

TRLS 3001.finalExam: No traditional tests or exams; team project presentations are in week 16 (Nov 30-Dec 6).
TRLS 3001.attendance: Regular on-time attendance and active participation are essential in this small-group seminar.
TRLS 3001.lateWork: Complete work by posted deadlines; extensions may be granted at the instructor's discretion for documented circumstances.
TRLS 3001.makeups: Notify the instructor as soon as possible about illness or documented emergency; some assignments cannot be made up because they involve discussions and guest speakers.
other: Grade appeals must be emailed within one week after grades are posted.
Scores are posted to eLC within one week after each deadline.
Students must acknowledge AI use when required and check the accuracy of AI-generated content.

objectives: Students will experience enhanced student-faculty interactions in a small class setting.
Students will enhance their academic skills through academic writing and communication activities.
Students will develop creative thought and effective reasoning skills.
Student will learn about intentional and reflective learning.
Students will learn about the importance of fostering academic connections to promote their academic and post-graduate success.
Students will learn about opportunities to engage in research, public service, internships, practicums, experiential learning, field study, and study abroad.
Student will engage in campus events that highlight an aspect of the mission of the University.
